subtasks.title: Typed Printify client: createOrder with mock fetch and error mapping
subtasks.description: POST order with external_id = Stripe session id; 409/8503 treated as success; errors mapped to codes without provider text.
subtasks.details:
Files: lib/printify.ts (new), tests/fixtures/mock-printify.mjs (new; scripted fake fetch that records calls, like tests/fixtures/mock-stripe.mjs; no network), tests/printify-client.test.mjs (new). Use global fetch with an injectable fetch parameter for tests; no SDK, no new dependency. Base https://api.printify.com/v1/, endpoint POST shops/{shop_id}/orders.json; headers Authorization: Bearer <token>, User-Agent: TsuyaNoUchi, Content-Type: application/json; timeout via AbortSignal.timeout (e.g. 15s). Config from lib/printify-config.ts (subtask 18.4). Input type: externalId (cs_ session id), label, lineItems [{productId: string, variantId: number, quantity, externalId}], shippingMethod fixed 1, sendShippingNotification false, addressTo fields per docs/PRINTIFY_FULFILLMENT.md section 2. Result union: {ok:true, printifyOrderId, duplicate:boolean} or {ok:false, code: validation|not_found|ineligible|auth|rate_limited|server|network|timeout, retryable:boolean, providerCode?:number, retryAfterSeconds?:number}. Mapping per design section 5: 2xx -> ok with body.id; 409 with code 8503 -> ok duplicate:true with the existing id read from the body (shape Needs verification: tolerate missing id -> ok:false code server retryable false and note it); 400 -> validation; 401/403 -> auth; 404 -> not_found; 422 -> ineligible (all not retryable); 429 -> rate_limited retryable, parse Retry-After if present; 5xx -> server retryable; fetch throw -> network retryable; abort -> timeout retryable. Never include response text, address or email in errors, thrown messages or logs (use lib/safe-server-log.ts if logging at all). The client does not check PRINTIFY_ORDERS_ENABLED; the caller (task 19) does. No live calls in tests or anywhere.
